messages.author: 3015c1527bcf288d
messages.subject: "suppressing"  x-axis / legend
parts:
Hi,

how can i avoid printing the x-axis (not always a date), and avoid
printing
legend (but nevertheless different colours)
I find hint a hint about the latter with legend.position="none" but
didn't get success.

Many thanks for help,
Christian

dftest <- structure(list(date = structure(1:12, .Label = c("12.10.10",
"13.10.10", "14.10.10", "15.10.10", "16.10.10", "17.10.10",
"26.10.10",
"27.10.10", "28.10.10", "29.10.10", "30.10.10", "31.10.10"), class =
"factor"),
group = c("MIC", "MIC", "MIC", "MIC", "MIC", "MIC", "SE",
"SE", "SE", "SE", "SE", "SE"), value = c(0.2, 0.21, 0.22,
0.23, 0.22, 0.23, 0.38, 0.39, 0.41, 0.43, 0.43, 0.42)), .Names =
c("date",
"group", "value"), row.names = c(NA, -12L), class = "data.frame")

p <- ggplot(dftest,aes(x=date,y=value,group=group,colour=group))
p + geom_line(size=I(1.8)) +
scale_y_continuous("value",formatter="percent") +
scale_colour_hue("Group") + scale_x_discrete("Date") +
opts(title="Title",legend_position="none")

messages.author: 66a7bbbceef834e9
messages.subject: Re: "suppressing" x-axis / legend
parts: Hi, there's a typo in your code. It's legend.position not legeng_position. And + xlab("") should work to remove the x axis label.

dftest <- structure(list(date = structure(1:12, .Label = c("12.10.10",
"13.10.10", "14.10.10", "15.10.10", "16.10.10", "17.10.10",
"26.10.10",
"27.10.10", "28.10.10", "29.10.10", "30.10.10", "31.10.10"), class =
"factor"),
   group = c("MIC", "MIC", "MIC", "MIC", "MIC", "MIC", "SE",
   "SE", "SE", "SE", "SE", "SE"), value = c(0.2, 0.21, 0.22,
   0.23, 0.22, 0.23, 0.38, 0.39, 0.41, 0.43, 0.43, 0.42)), .Names =
c("date",
"group", "value"), row.names = c(NA, -12L), class = "data.frame")

p <- ggplot(dftest,aes(x=date,y=value,group=group,colour=group))
 p + geom_line(size=I(1.8)) +
scale_y_continuous("value",formatter="percent") +
scale_colour_hue("Group") + scale_x_discrete("Date")  +

opts(title="Title",legend.position="none") + xlab("")

HTH 
Luciano
